## Problem

What friction, failure mode, coverage gap, or reuse problem does this change address?

## Change

What is the smallest coherent change?

## Evidence

- [ ] Repository validation passes
- [ ] Generated README/catalog and goal libraries are synchronized
- [ ] All recommended launchers run unchanged with no placeholders
- [ ] Profile inputs and execution rules are aligned
- [ ] Agent Skills CLI discovers both skills
- [ ] Reusable ZIP packages build
- [ ] New or changed behavior has a worked example or verifier

## Compatibility

Does this affect skill invocation, zero-friction handoff, Goal Contracts, input ledgers, profiles, overlays, standalone fallbacks, state paths, portfolios, or archived results?

## Versioning

- [ ] `VERSION`, both skill metadata files, and `CHANGELOG.md` are aligned
- [ ] Migration notes are included when needed
- [ ] Machine-readable catalog and generated collections are updated

## Safety

- [ ] Production edits remain forbidden before contract approval
- [ ] Shaping cannot be mistaken for goal completion
- [ ] No authority boundary was broadened unintentionally
- [ ] No secrets, private data, production dumps, exploit-enabling evidence, or unnecessary logs are included
- [ ] Canonical sources—not generated outputs—were edited
